## [Lulu and Georgia Kukka Sconce no bulbs fit it](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/65f4bc8ae6691e5a96ef5aab)
Bought the Kukka light sconce and the only actual size light bulb that fits it is a night light bulb. Unbelievable. No real customer service just emails. I didn’t even bother this time to email them because they are clueless. In addition, am now waiting about 5 plus months for pillows I ordered and was charged for, who knows if those are coming.

March 15, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Mar 18, 2024

Hi Laura, Thank you for your feedback and we’re so sorry to hear about this experience with us. We sent you a request through Trustpilot to gather a little more information about your experience so we can escalate this to our Customer Experience team.
